samples.content:
<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cctype>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <sstream>
#include <locale>

using namespace std;

class J {
private:
    static const bool ONLINE_JUDGE = getenv("ONLINE_JUDGE") != nullptr;

    istream* in;
    ostream* out;
    vector<string> tokens;
    int tokenIndex;

    void init() {
        locale::global(locale("en_US.UTF-8"));
        string fileName = "";
        if (ONLINE_JUDGE && fileName.empty()) {
            in = &cin;
            out = &cout;
        } else {
            if (fileName.empty()) {
                // in = new ifstream("input.txt");
                // out = new ofstream("output.txt");
                in = &cin;
                out = &cout;
            } else {
                // in = new ifstream(fileName + ".in");
                // out = new ofstream(fileName + ".out");
                in = &cin;
                out = &cout;
            }
        }
        tokenIndex = 0;
    }

    string readString() {
        while (tokenIndex >= tokens.size()) {
            string line;
            getline(*in, line);
            istringstream iss(line);
            tokens.clear();
            tokenIndex = 0;
            string token;
            while (iss >> token) {
                tokens.push_back(token);
            }
        }
        return tokens[tokenIndex++];
    }

    int readInt() {
        return stoi(readString());
    }

    long long readLong() {
        return stoll(readString());
    }

    double readDouble() {
        return stod(readString());
    }

    vector<int> readIntArray(int size) {
        vector<int> a(size);
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            a[i] = readInt();
        }
        return a;
    }

    long long timeBegin, timeEnd;

    void time() {
        timeEnd = chrono::duration_cast<chrono::milliseconds>(
            chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
        cerr << "Time = " << (timeEnd - timeBegin) << endl;
    }

    int count(const string& s, char target, int v, int k, int x) {
        int answer = 0;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (c == 'V') {
                v--;
                if (v == 0 && target == 'V') return answer;
                if (v < 0) answer++;
            }
            if (c == 'K') {
                k--;
                if (k == 0 && target == 'K') return answer;
                if (k < 0) answer++;
            }
            if (c == 'X') {
                x--;
                if (x == 0 && target == 'X') return answer;
                if (x < 0) answer++;
            }
        }
        throw runtime_error("count failed");
    }

    void solve() {
        int n = readInt();
        string input = readString();
        string s = input;
        int vcnt = 0, kcnt = 0, xcnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            if (s[i] == 'V') {
                vcnt++;
                continue;
            }
            if (s[i] == 'K') {
                kcnt++;
                continue;
            }
            xcnt++;
            s[i] = 'X';
        }

        const int INF = 10000000;
        vector<vector<vector<vector<int>>>> dp(vcnt + 1, 
            vector<vector<vector<int>>>(kcnt + 1,
                vector<vector<int>>(xcnt + 1,
                    vector<int>(3, INF))));

        dp[0][0][0][0] = dp[0][0][0][1] = dp[0][0][0][2] = 0;

        for (int v = 0; v <= vcnt; v++) {
            for (int k = 0; k <= kcnt; k++) {
                for (int x = 0; x <= xcnt; x++) {
                    int rv = (v + 1 <= vcnt) ? count(s, 'V', v + 1, k, x) : 0;
                    int rk = (k + 1 <= kcnt) ? count(s, 'K', v, k + 1, x) : 0;
                    int rx = (x + 1 <= xcnt) ? count(s, 'X', v, k, x + 1) : 0;

                    for (int now = 0; now < 3; now++) {
                        if (v + 1 <= vcnt) {
                            dp[v + 1][k][x][0] = min(dp[v + 1][k][x][0], dp[v][k][x][now] + rv);
                        }
                        if (now != 0 && k + 1 <= kcnt) {
                            dp[v][k + 1][x][1] = min(dp[v][k + 1][x][1], dp[v][k][x][now] + rk);
                        }
                        if (x + 1 <= xcnt) {
                            dp[v][k][x + 1][2] = min(dp[v][k][x + 1][2], dp[v][k][x][now] + rx);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int res = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            res = min(res, dp[vcnt][kcnt][xcnt][i]);
        }
        *out << res << endl;
    }

public:
    void run() {
        try {
            timeBegin = chrono::duration_cast<chrono::milliseconds>(
                chrono::system_clock::now().time_since_epoch()).count();
            init();
            solve();
            time();
        } catch (const exception& e) {
            cerr << e.what() << endl;
            exit(-1);
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    J solver;
    solver.run();
    return 0;
}
